Order + orient a path's scaffolds along a reference and stitch them

Source: R/stitch_scaffolds.R
stitch_scaffolds.Rd

Order + orient a path's scaffolds along a reference and stitch them

Usage

stitch_scaffolds(
  path_fasta,
  reference_fasta,
  max_gap = 2000,
  min_hit = 100,
  min_new = 200
)

Arguments

path_fasta

Fasta of one path's scaffolds.

reference_fasta

Fasta with a single reference rDNA sequence (e.g. the top BLAST hit's full 18S-ITS-28S sequence).

max_gap

Cap (bp) on the N-gap inserted between non-abutting scaffolds (default 2000); larger reference gaps are clamped to this.

min_hit

Minimum BLAST alignment length (bp) to place a scaffold (default 100); unplaced scaffolds are appended at the end and flagged.

min_new

Minimum new reference coverage (bp) a scaffold must add to be kept in the tiling; scaffolds contained within a larger one are dropped as redundant (default 200).

Value

list(sequence = character stitched sequence, layout = data.frame(scaffold, ref_start, ref_end, strand, placed, length, redundant, order), n_gaps, n_unplaced, n_redundant)
